desc: The Ascension takes a timeless Monte Carlo style stock to the next level with it's ergonomics and design. The higher comb and grip come together for an extremely comfortable fit. This platform is backed by our sub 1/2 MOA accuracy guarantee and ready to tackle everything a high-country hunt demands. The Ascension comes standard with our Sendero contour carbon fiber barrel, Trigger Tech trigger, BDL style magazine and a world class titanium receiver from Zermatt Arms.
